title: Contact
h1: Contact Palisoft — let’s discuss your SaaS, marketplace or MVP
intro: Get in touch — let's discuss your task and timeline.
seoTitle: Contact Palisoft — Discuss Your SaaS or MVP Project
seoDescription: Tell us about your product via email or Telegram — we'll discuss scope, timeline and an estimate. Working remotely, worldwide, in English and Russian.
ogAlt: Contact Palisoft — email and Telegram, remote worldwide
availability: Remote · working worldwide · English and Russian
briefTitle: What to write in the first message
brief: What the product does and for whom — two or three sentences are enough
Where it stands: an idea, a prototype, or a working system that needs to grow
Timeline and constraints: launch date, budget range, existing stack or team
Links, if any: current site, repository, mockups, competitors

process.title: Reply within one business day
process.text: We answer by email or Telegram, ask clarifying questions and suggest a time for a call.

process.title: A 30–60 minute call
process.text: We go through the product, its users and constraints, and agree on what the first release must contain.

process.title: Estimate and plan
process.text: Within a few days you get a written scope, an estimate with a range, milestones and an architecture outline — free of charge and without obligation.

process.title: Start
process.text: Contract, first milestone, weekly demos. The code lives in your repository from the first commit.
